tutorial.title: Tutorial
tutorial.step1: You can open the settings by clicking on a website.
tutorial.step2: You can enable/disable the website by clicking on its switch.
tutorial.step3: You can add a custom website by clicking the "Add Site" button.
tutorial.step4: You can manage your scripts by clicking the "Open Script Manager" button.
tutorial.step5: You can block or edit title/artist by clicking the "Open Filters" button.
tutorial.step6: You can access the server dashboard by clicking the "Open Dashboard" button.
tutorial.step7: You can click the "Open Activity Library" button to install activities.

userscript.apiWarn.intro:
This section relies on the {bold_api} to inject and manage custom scripts.
However, your browser has not granted this permission yet.
userscript.apiWarn.whyText: Without this permission, you cannot create custom user scripts for websites or access the activity library.
userscript.apiWarn.fixStep1: Click the puzzle-piece icon in the top-right corner of the browser.
userscript.apiWarn.fixStep2: In the menu that opens, click "Manage Extensions".
userscript.apiWarn.fixStep3-moz: Find the extension and click on it.
userscript.apiWarn.fixStep4: Look for a permission setting related to {code_permission} and enable it.
